verdict.rationale: Delaware's own pages show annual reports and franchise taxes are filed and paid online, are in fact required to be filed online, and name reservation is also online. Entity formation, the founder's core transaction, is only done by submitting fillable PDFs through the Document Filing and Certificate Request Service (upload), or by fax or mail, and the evidence says formation has no transactional portal. missing for 10: an end-to-end online formation flow (formation is PDF upload, fax or mail rather than an online form/register portal), and hands-on confirmation that the filing flow completes online (the CAPTCHA entry page was never interacted with).

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages

citations.quote: All active Domestic Corporation Annual Reports and Franchise Taxes for the prior year are due annually on or before March 1st and are required to be filed online.
FILE YOUR ANNUAL REPORT AND PAY BUSINESS ENTITY TAX. This application is available daily between 8:00 am and 11:45 pm Eastern Time.
You can reserve your entity name online.
The entity forms are PDF fillable and can be submitted using our Document Filing and Certificate Request Service or by mail.
